messages:
Nora: Quick RFC follow-up: finalizing fallback ordering, SLO triggers, and CI requirements for new quant profiles (FP8 / INT8 / 4-bit). Posting condensed checklist.
Vik: Thanks. High level checklist please.
Nora: Checklist: 1) Canary sampling: 0.5% initial, expand to 2% after stability window. 2) Shadow sampling: 5% for fidelity traces. 3) Observation window: 30m OR 2500 reqs. 4) Metrics: ensemble = deg_score + token_coherence + p95 latency. 5) Auto actions: immediate rollback on catastrophic latency/error; staged reduction for quality regressions.
Chen: Define catastrophic thresholds?
Nora: Catastrophic = p99 latency +200ms vs baseline OR error_rate increase >0.75%. Staged quality trigger = ensemble delta > 1.8% absolute OR snr_drop_db >3 across window.
Maya: How do we compute SNR reproducibly?
Nora: SNR = 10 * log10(Var(baseline_embeddings) / Var(baseline - quantized)). We keep per-model baseline stats in eval-store and snapshot at release time.
Vik: Fallback policy? auto-switch to INT8 or revert to float?
Nora: Fallback order: tenant_override (if set) -> INT8-compatible profile -> float32. Rationale: prefer preserving cost savings (INT8) unless customer asked otherwise. Must log fallback decision with reason.
Chen: Telemetry and tracing requirements?
Nora: Every request must carry: header X-Quant-Profile and X-Quant-Flags (comma-separated). Traces must include trace.quant.profile and trace.quant.flags tags. Logs must include deg_score and snr_db sample. Example log: {"ts":"...","req":"r1","quant_profile":"fp8-alpha","flags":"stochastic","deg_score":0.012,"snr_db":2.1}.
Maya: What about stochastic rounding and determinism?
Nora: Stochastic rounding is allowed behind infra flag quant.stochastic_rounding=true and must be shadowed at 1% before rollout. If enabled, record seed metadata in traces for reproducibility.
Vik: Per-request vs per-token precision?
Nora: Start with per-request only for safety. Per-token mixed precision is allowed in experiments behind a feature gate and requires separate canary + offline eval.
Chen: CI / PR rules?
Nora: PR that touches quant profiles must include: a) YAML canary block in model manifest, b) perf/quality microbench report (shadow playback), c) runbook snippet with fallback and contact list. CI should fail if any missing.
Maya: Ops playbook steps?
Nora: Ops playbook: 1) On staged trigger: reduce sample by 50%, notify SRE + model owner. 2) Wait 20m; if metric still breaching -> full rollback. 3) On catastrophic trigger: immediate rollback + page on-call. Canary-bot will create incident with suggested rollback command.
ops-bot: canary started: model=redwood-mosaic-fp8-experimental sample=0.5% shadow=5%
Vik: One last ask: add automated bootstrap CI for deg_score significance (95% CI) so we don't react to noise.
Nora: Agreed, will add bootstrapped CIs to monitoring playbook and CI lint. I'll draft the PRs and link them here.
Maya: LGTM, thanks.
